title: Design System: Smart Search for macOS

native.visualAcceptance: partial real GUI verification: search/provider/activity widths, compact settings and operation feedback at 920 pt; English, dark appearance and wide-window checks remain pending
native.representation: 保留原生 API；不生成固定 CSS 色值、色阶、Web 断点或 HTML 控件仿制。

splitViews.api: NSSplitViewController inside the existing SwiftUI Scene
splitViews.persistence: UserDefaults per page; temporary narrow-window clamping retains preferred width

settings.panels: DesktopPanel(compact: true), including every CLI group
settings.automaticUpdateRow: leading wrapping description with trailing fixed-size native switch
settings.visualAcceptance: observed at 920 pt in a settings-start preview: update switch alignment, App and CLI updates, runtime and advanced panels; English, dark appearance and wider windows pending

routingEditor.placement: plain text first row in the shared scrolling provider list, below the search field

modes.hybrid: embedding and classifier configuration with shared timeout
modes.jev: TypeSafe credentials, retrieval judgments and result processing

routingEditor.conditionalFields: JEV filtering threshold only while filtering is enabled
routingEditor.choiceLabels: localized display labels; raw backend values are preserved

secretFields.existingValue: fixed mask shown as SecureField prompt, never as a draft value
secretFields.presence: backend Boolean secret_presence distinguishes empty and configured keys
secretFields.clear: explicit clear action; typing a replacement removes the pending clear

providerNavigation.classification: runtime provider_profiles.capability; field capabilities only as fallback
providerNavigation.rows: one occurrence per provider; name, configuration state and unsaved marker
providerNavigation.subtitle: localized runtime strengths and all declared capabilities; experimental and explicit-only restrictions retained
providerNavigation.search: name, purpose and all capabilities; selection and drafts remain stable

operationFeedback.presentation: SwiftUI popover below an always-present toolbar button; page hierarchy and height remain stable
operationFeedback.overflow: ViewThatFits with a native ScrollView; heading and clear button stay outside the scrolling content
operationFeedback.content: complete selectable text; error heading with warning symbol, neutral ordinary messages
operationFeedback.lifecycle: dismiss and reopen retained messages; explicit clear disables the entry; repeated foreground failures present again, unchanged background polling failures do not
operationFeedback.visualAcceptance: observed in a 920 pt Chinese/light settings-start preview with explicit sample messages: long installation guidance, dismiss/reopen/clear, repeated errors and notices, 30-paragraph scrolling; no real install or configuration write triggered

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: 整行展开；accessibilityReduceMotion 开启时使用 nil animation。

workspace.scrollContent: Width bounded by the viewport; leading aligned

windows.actions: Native buttons wrap at their measured widths; shared footer has a top divider and trailing actions

mascot.placement: bottom edge of expanded sidebar, no frame; hidden with collapsed navigation

windows.verification: Native Windows x64 publish and packaged backend startup passed. Preview 20260921T101447Z launched; overview alignment, compact toolbar and shifted bottom mascot observed. Final details/settings interactions and dark/English/narrow visual checks remain pending; not upstream acceptance.

toolbarIcons.style: native Button with centered system icon

components.name: 主要操作
components.description: 保存、运行和更新；进行中显示 BusyLabel，按条件禁用。

components.name: 原生输入
components.description: 保留系统标签、编辑、焦点和禁用语义。

components.name: 主导航
components.description: 六个工作区及底部连接状态。

components.name: 状态标签
components.description: 文字加状态色；Capsule 底色透明度 0.12。

components.name: 内容面板
components.description: 语义背景、连续圆角、细边界，无自定义投影。

components.name: 整行展开
components.description: 真实 Button、键盘操作、展开状态与减少动态效果分支。

components.name: 任务分栏
components.description: 左侧选择或输入，右侧编辑或阅读结果；各栏独立滚动，原生分隔条可拖动。

components.name: 操作提示
components.description: 工具栏入口打开系统浮层；保留完整消息、长文滚动、关闭后重看和显式清除，不改变页面布局。

narrative.northStar: Apple 原生 macOS 工作台
narrative.overview: 使用系统窗口、字体与控件建立熟悉感。Codex Tweaks 提供结构参考，Smart Search 保留自己的名称和图标。先呈现主要任务、必要状态与下一步行动，技术细节按需进入。
keyCharacteristics: 原生、清楚、克制；真实状态；稳定留白。

rules.name: The 语义颜色 Rule
rules.body: 保留系统 API，不以固定 Hex 替代；状态必须有文字依据。

dos: Do 复用原生组件和统一间距，保持任务与返回上下文。
Do 为状态提供文字、为图标提供名称，并验证浅深色、缩放和键盘焦点。
donts: Don't 用 CSS 仿制品、固定色值或额外阴影替代原生系统。
Don't 让技术详情抢占主要任务，或将编译、打包视为视觉验收。
